name: Kuraishi Rin
source:
A classmate who is good friends with Maika.
Her calm and innocent demeanor makes her popular among boys in a different manner from Maika, but in secret, she earns spending money by providing aid to others.

She was not keen on the confession game, but after the game's initiator, Maika, was rejected, she begins to take an interest in it.
